sourceFilesDigestEncoding: Concatenate source-root-relative sorted UTF-8 file path, NUL, original file bytes, NUL; SHA-256 of complete concatenation.
generation: Parsed every Windows Terminal JSON object from the pinned archive, preserved all fields and values, sorted by source filename, serialized as a JSON array. No upstream scripts executed. All 811 schemes/*.itermcolors files have corresponding Windows Terminal palettes; every named yaml/*.yml palette is included.
individualThemeRights: The collection MIT license does not replace individual theme authors’ copyrights/licenses; upstream attribution is reproduced in CREDITS.md.
semanticAdapter: Original terminal colors remain unchanged in catalog.json and Theme.terminalPalette. Grain semantic colors are contrast-adjusted derived colors, not upstream originals.
